hosts.name: Michael
hosts.text: On your turn: Discard a card from another player's Choir, then discard this card.

hosts.name: Wisdom
hosts.text: When you Offer or Exalt, look at the top 2 cards of the Host deck. Put 1 into your hand and discard the other.

hosts.name: Gabriel
hosts.text: In the Morning: Look at another player's hand, then name Light or Dark. If they Offer a card of that alignment this Day, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Providence
hosts.text: At the end of each Day your Choir leans with the Tide, put 1 Glory from the Pot on this card. On your turn: You may take all the Glory on it, then discard this card.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Confession
hosts.text: On your turn: Reveal your hand to the table and keep it revealed until the end of your next turn. If it holds no Dark card, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Tree of Life
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leaned with the Tide today and yesterday, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Free Will
hosts.text: On your turn: Take a second action, then discard this card.

hosts.name: Seraphim
hosts.text: When you Exalt a Light card, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Hymn
hosts.text: When you Offer this card, it goes face up.

hosts.name: Raphael
hosts.text: When you Offer a Light card, you may turn it face up to destroy a face-up Dark card on the Altar.

hosts.name: Sanctuary
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose 1 card on the Altar. For the rest of this Day, it cannot be Gathered or destroyed by other players.

hosts.name: Uriel
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir has 3 or more other Light cards, gain 2 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Martyr
hosts.text: When another card is discarded from your Choir, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: When a card leaves your Choir

hosts.name: Covenant
hosts.text: In the Morning: You may name another player. If neither of you Offers this Day, each of you gains 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Tribute
hosts.text: Other players must pay you 1 Glory before they may Target any card in your Choir.

hosts.name: Mercy
hosts.text: If yours is the only Choir against the Tide, lose 1 instead of 3, then discard this card.

hosts.name: Revelation
hosts.text: On your turn: Flip a facedown Altar card face up. You may then flip a face-up Altar card facedown.

hosts.name: Cherubim
hosts.text: Your Host cards cannot be Replaced or Discarded by other players' abilities. They may still be Copied or Flipped.

hosts.name: Morning Star
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose a card in your Choir. It counts as the opposite alignment this Day.

hosts.name: Absolution
hosts.text: When a Host card is discarded from your Choir, you may return it to your hand instead, then discard 1 card from your hand.
hosts.cadence: When a card leaves your Choir

hosts.name: Knowledge
hosts.text: On your turn: Secretly look at up to 3 facedown Altar cards.

hosts.name: Deliverance
hosts.text: On your turn: Swap a card between any two players' Choirs, then discard this card.

hosts.name: Remnant
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If 2 or more places in your Choir are empty, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Vessel
hosts.text: On your turn: You may place a card from your hand on the Altar facedown (this is not an Offer). At the end of the Day, if it is still there, gain 1 Glory if it matches the Tide, or lose 1 if it opposes it.

hosts.name: Eternity
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: You may keep one card on the Altar, face up, through the next Day.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Ordeal
hosts.text: On your turn: You may invoke this card. At this Reaping, double the Glory you gain or lose from your Choir's Alignment.

hosts.name: Raguel
hosts.text: When this enters your Choir, choose another player. They are Bound to you while it remains. At the end of the Day, if they gained Glory at the Reaping, gain 1 Glory; if they lost Glory at the Reaping, lose 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Twilight
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If the other cards in your Choir hold as many Light cards as Dark cards (at least 1 each), gain 2 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Zealot
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If every other card in your Choir (at least 3) shares one alignment, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Stillness
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If the Tide was Neutral (a tie or an empty Altar), gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Acolyte
hosts.text: This card's alignment matches the previous Day's Tide: Light +1 after a Light Tide, Dark +1 after a Dark Tide. After a Neutral Tide, or on Day 1, it is Neutral.

hosts.name: Nephilim
hosts.text: This card counts as both Light +1 and Dark +1 at once. It satisfies any effect requiring a Light card and any requiring a Dark card. For your Alignment and the Tide, its two values are Neutral.

hosts.name: Firmament
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If the Tide won by exactly 1 and your Choir leans with it, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Moderation
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leans neither way, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Fig Leaves
hosts.text: In the Evening, before the Altar is revealed: You may have your Choir sit out this Day. It gains nothing, loses nothing, and does not count as leaning either way.

hosts.name: Flaming Sword
hosts.text: On your turn: No other player may Exalt or Gather until the start of your next turn.

hosts.name: Outcast
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If you have the least Glory (or are tied for it), gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Heresy
hosts.text: On your turn: You may pay 1 Glory. Your Choir counts as leaning the opposite way this Day.

hosts.name: Council
hosts.text: In the Morning: You may name another player. At the end of the Day, if your Choirs lean the same way, each of you gains 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Mirage
hosts.text: Other players cannot Gather, flip, look at, exchange, or destroy cards you placed on the Altar before the Evening.

hosts.name: Veil
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If more Altar cards were facedown than face up when it was revealed, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Prophecy
hosts.text: In the Morning: Declare Light or Dark. At the end of the Day, if the Tide matches, gain 1 Glory; otherwise (a Neutral Tide included), lose 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Watchers
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at the top 3 cards of the Host deck. Put 1 into your hand and discard a card from your hand, then return the rest in any order.

hosts.name: Apple
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leans the other way from yesterday, gain 2 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Forger
hosts.text: When you Gather or Exalt, you may take the card from the discard pile instead.

hosts.name: Jubilee
hosts.text: On your turn: You may discard any number of cards from your hand, then draw back up to your hand limit.

hosts.name: Anathema
hosts.text: On your turn: No other player may Offer until the start of your next turn.

hosts.name: Serpent
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at another player's hand, then you may exchange 1 card from your hand for 1 card in theirs.

hosts.name: Favor
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If 2 or more other players lost Glory at the Reaping, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Temptation
hosts.text: On your turn: Play a card from your hand into another player's Choir. If their Choir is full, they discard one of its cards first.

hosts.name: Legion
hosts.text: When you Exalt a Dark card, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Lamentation
hosts.text: When you Offer this card, it goes face up.

hosts.name: Azazel
hosts.text: When you Offer a Dark card, you may turn it face up to destroy a face-up Light card on the Altar.

hosts.name: Moloch
hosts.text: On your turn: You may discard 1 other Host card from your Choir to gain 1 Glory. Its ability must not have been used this turn.

hosts.name: Beelzebub
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir has 3 or more other Dark cards, gain 2 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Leviathan
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If the Tide won by 3 or more and your Choir leans with it, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Hubris
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If the player with the most Glory gained 4 or more Glory this Day, they give 1 to you.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Belial
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at a facedown Altar card. You may swap it with a card from your hand.

hosts.name: Mammon
hosts.text: At the end of each Day your Choir leans with the Tide, put 1 Glory from the Pot on this card. On your turn: You may take all the Glory on it, then discard this card.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Envy
hosts.text: On your turn: If the player with the most Glory has at least 3 more Glory than you, they lose 1 Glory. Each tied leader loses 1.

hosts.name: Lilith
hosts.text: When a card is discarded from another player's Choir, you may put it into your hand.
hosts.cadence: When a card leaves a Choir

hosts.name: Parasite
hosts.text: When you Exalt or Gather this card, put it into another player's Choir instead. They cannot discard it. At the end of each Day, if they lost Glory at the Reaping, you gain 1 Glory; if they gained Glory at the Reaping, discard this card.

hosts.name: Winnowing
hosts.text: On your turn: Discard up to 2 facedown Altar cards without looking at them.

hosts.name: Silence
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose a player. Their Choir's abilities do not work until your next turn.

hosts.name: Scapegoat
hosts.text: When another player would gain Glory at the Reaping, you may pay 1 Glory. They gain nothing.

hosts.name: Defiance
hosts.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leans with the Tide and more Choirs leaned against it than with it, gain 1 Glory.
hosts.cadence: At the end of the Day

hosts.name: Bounty
hosts.text: In the Morning: You may name a player. At the end of the Day, if they lost Glory at the Reaping, gain 1 Glory; if they gained Glory at the Reaping, lose 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Abaddon
hosts.text: On your turn: Replace every Altar card with the top card of the Host deck, then discard this card.

hosts.name: Snare
hosts.text: When another player Gathers, flips, or discards a card you placed on the Altar, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Ithuriel
hosts.text: On your turn: Flip one facedown card on the Altar face up.

hosts.name: Urim
hosts.text: On your turn: Secretly look at up to 3 facedown cards on the Altar.

hosts.name: Asmadai
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at one facedown card on the Altar. You may exchange it with a card from your hand. The new card stays facedown.

celestials.name: The Tempest
celestials.text: When you Offer, you may destroy a face-up card on the Altar.

celestials.name: The Oracle
celestials.text: In the Morning: Look at the top 2 Event cards. Play one, and put the other on the bottom of the Event deck.

celestials.name: The Eclipse
celestials.text: In the Evening: Choose a card in your Choir. It counts as Neutral at this Day's Reaping.

celestials.name: The Cantor
celestials.text: When you Offer, you may Offer a second card of the same alignment (Light, Dark, or Neutral). Both go face up, and each earns its reward.

celestials.name: The Patron
celestials.text: On your turn: Play a card from your hand into another player's Choir. If it is full, they discard one of its cards first.

celestials.name: The Echo
celestials.text: On your turn: Use the On your turn ability of a card in another player's Choir, as if it were yours. Spent cards cannot be copied.

celestials.name: The Dominion
celestials.text: Your hand limit is 5 instead of 3. Begin the game with 5 cards in hand.

celestials.name: The Whisper
celestials.text: In the Morning: Name Light or Dark aloud. At the Reaping, if the Tide matches, your Choir counts as leaning with it.

celestials.name: The Arbiter
celestials.text: When you gain Glory at the Reaping, take 1 of it from another player: one whose Choir leaned against the Tide, if any of them has Glory.

events.name: Creation
events.text: In the Morning, reveal 3 Host cards from the deck onto the Altar.

events.name: Manna
events.text: Each player draws 1 card; hand limits increase by 1 this Day. Discard back to your limit in the Evening.

events.name: Ascension
events.text: Light cards on the Altar count double when the Tide is set.

events.name: Let There Be Light
events.text: The abilities of Dark Host cards in Choirs do not work this Day, including abilities that work on their own. The cards still count toward Alignment. Neutral cards are unaffected.

events.name: The Sabbath
events.text: The Balance marker does not move this Day. The Reaping still occurs.

events.name: Divine Calling
events.text: When you Exalt this Day, gain 1 Glory.

events.name: Dispersion
events.text: Each player passes their entire hand to the player on their left.

events.name: Equilibrium
events.text: In the Morning, move the Balance marker 1 space toward the center. No effect if it is already on the center space.

events.name: Purgatory
events.text: No Choir loses Glory at the Reaping this Day. A Choir that leans neither way gains 1 Glory.

events.name: Casting Lots
events.text: Each player secretly predicts the Tide in the Morning: Light, Dark, or Neutral. At the Reaping, a correct call gains 1 Glory (2 for Neutral); a wrong call loses 1.

events.name: Pandemonium
events.text: First Fruits are placed facedown, and no card on the Altar may be flipped or looked at before the Evening.

events.name: False Prophecy
events.text: Set the Tide and move the Balance marker as normal. During the Reaping, score as if the Tide ran the opposite direction.

events.name: Famine
events.text: No Choir gains or loses Glory at the Reaping this Day, and no Choir counts as leaning with or against the Tide.

events.name: Babel
events.text: No table talk or deals this Day.

events.name: Fall From Grace
events.text: Dark cards on the Altar count double when the Tide is set.

events.name: Armageddon
events.text: The Balance marker may move up to 3 spaces this Day.

events.name: The Plague
events.text: Each player discards 1 Host card from their Choir and replaces it from the top of the deck.

events.name: Tithe
events.text: Pay 1 Glory for each Host ability you activate this Day.

events.name: The Flood
events.text: The abilities of Light Host cards in Choirs do not work this Day, including abilities that work on their own. The cards still count toward Alignment. Neutral cards are unaffected.

events.name: The Fast
events.text: No one may Exalt, Turn, or spend Glory this Day.
